lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid arrangement of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gill slits, organized into approximately five observable horizontal rows with increasing inter-blob distance towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of prominent surface-refracted light caustics across the dorsal-lateral region and multiple commensal fish (remoras) visible beneath the pectoral fin and ventral area.
